items.title: After a brief lull, heavy rain is set to return to Tamil Nadu, with Chennai, coastal districts and parts of southern India likely to witness thunderstorms, gusty winds this week till November 27
items.summary: Starting from November 23 through November 27, Tamil Nadu is bracing for substantial rainfall, as per the India Meteorological Department's warnings of thunderstorms and strong winds. Key districts, including Chennai, Tiruvallur, and Chengalpattu, are anticipated to see particularly heavy rain. Residents in vulnerable areas, especially low-lying ones, should closely monitor weather updates. Drivers should be cautious of possibly impaired visibility and the likelihood of waterlogged roads.

items.title: THE BUTTERFLY LOVERS
items.summary: Ballet, storytelling, drama, exquisite choreography, and an extraordinary array of acrobatic staging make The Butterfly Lovers a feast for the senses, based on a classic love story from Chinese heritage between Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai. Described as a contemporary acrobatic production, it tells of a young woman who disguises herself as a man to be allowed to study. Drawn to a fellow student, she falls in love, but as she prepares to reveal her true identity, her family arrange an advantageous match with another man. Family loyalty and true love come into conflict in a tragedy of epic scale.
